title: Check if you have to pay tax on your pension
text:
You may have to pay tax on your pension depending on your income.

 At the end of this tool, you’ll get an estimate showing:

 • whether you need to pay tax on your pension

 • how much tax you may need to pay this year

 The result is based on you:

 • having the standard Personal Allowance of £12,570 (the amount you can earn before you have to pay tax)

 • starting to get your State Pension after 5 April 2010

 Before you start

 The tool will estimate your tax for this tax year (6 April to 5 April).

 You’ll need to know for this tax year:

 • what types of pensions you’ll get (for example, State Pension or private pension)

 • how much State Pension you’ll get — you can use your annual, weekly or 4-weekly amount

 • how much private pension you’ll get

 • the amount of any other taxable income you’ll get (for example, from employment or income from savings interest)

 • if you receive or transfer Marriage Allowance 

 You cannot include any foreign income or Blind Person’s Allowance you get.

 Check now
changeNote: Tool updated to provide an estimate of Income Tax you may need to pay when you get a pension.
